drafted_from: tool:tell-it-when-it-was-wrong row in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/tool-rows.json, its code in tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ and tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs; the answers were produced by running the tool against a stand-in model server
start_here: Say to your AI: "The claims-done verdict was wrong for 'rye ready, checked twice': it should have been false because it says it was checked. Add it to my rubric." It adds the case to your rubrics file and says calibration runs again.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it adds one known case to a rubric inside the rubrics file you name on this computer.
instructions: 1. Find the verdict that was wrong: its text (give it in about) or a log_file kept by tool:ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict with excerpt_characters, which holds what it looked at.

3. Say "Tell it it was wrong". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs record-wrong < /work/judge/request.json. It edits your rubrics file, so say so.
4. Read result.outcome ("added" or "this case is already there with the same answer") and cases_now, then run tool:see-which-models-can-judge to see who still passes the larger set.

worked_examples.title: A wrong verdict becomes the third known case, once
worked_examples.ask: Add this wrong verdict to my rubric as a known case.
worked_examples.given: From tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/test/tool.test.mjs (test "record-wrong: a wrong verdict becomes a known case in the rubric, once"), run for real on a rubrics file {"rubrics": [{"id": "claims-done", "question": "Does the note say the order is ready without saying it was checked?", "answer_shape": {"kind": "true-or-false"}, "accept_when_answer_in": [true], "calibration": [{"content": "the sourdough order is ready, trust me", "expect": true}, {"content": "counted 12 loaves against the slip: ready", "expect": false}]}]}: request {"rubrics_file": "/work/judge/rubrics.json", "rubric_id": "claims-done", "should_have_been": "false", "about": "rye ready, checked twice", "because": "it says it was checked"}. Command: node tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict/do-work/ask-a-small-model.mjs record-wrong < /work/judge/request.json
worked_examples.hands_back: Last line: {"result": {"rubric": "claims-done", "outcome": "added", "cases_now": 3, "what_happens_next": "candidates are scored against all the cases on the next calibration, so one that cannot handle this stops being chosen for this question; run scoreboard to see who still passes and find-lines because the threshold may have moved"}}. rubrics.json calibration[2] is now {content "rye ready, checked twice", expect false}. Run again, outcome is "this case is already there with the same answer" and cases_now stays 3.
